task.description: Write test spec and test code for API-02: Process definition CRUD. Create tests/specs/API-02.md covering all 7 routes and all acceptance criteria from the requirement. Write integration test cases in tests/integration/ (or extend existing definition_test.zig) covering: POST /definitions (201 + body), GET /definitions (list + pagination), GET /definitions/:id (200 + 404), PUT /definitions/:id (200 DRAFT, 409 non-DRAFT), PATCH /definitions/:id (200 DRAFT, 409 non-DRAFT), DELETE /definitions/:id (204 DRAFT, 200 ACTIVE archive, 404 not found), POST /definitions/:id/activate (200 DRAFT→ACTIVE, 409 non-DRAFT, 422 validation failure). Include role guard tests where applicable.
